title: DeepSeek answers keep their reasoning separate
summary:
Text responses got cleaner formatting and safer ad placement, while two community bots got easier to find.

The DeepSeek-v3 formatter was disabled, so reasoning content is no longer moved into the answer or wrapped in `<think>` tags. Streaming responses also bypass the SSE formatter when none is configured.

Text chat ads moved from local affiliate matching to the nex.ad API, with Ko-fi as a fallback. Ads are appended rather than replacing the assistant’s answer, and JSON-mode responses skip them.

The project lists added ImageEditer, a Telegram bot for generating and remixing images, and updated Gacha’s listing with a direct Discord invite and a place in the README’s new Social Bots section.
